name: 89434 · Sparks, NV
findings: ZIP 89434 (Sparks) has 48 nonprofit organizations. 18 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 13 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 89434 (Sparks) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 89434 (Sparks) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 51% of the typical level).
